selection_timing.note: This record freezes the oracle and comparison boundary only. It contains no model-derived values and is not execution evidence.

trusted_reference.canonical_accumulator: explicit left-to-right IEEE-754 float32 multiply followed by float32 add for every input column
trusted_reference.cross_check: NumPy float32 matrix-vector multiplication over the same independently dequantized rows
trusted_reference.suitability_reason: The immutable official GGUF Python source reads tensor metadata without model execution and its Q8_0 implementation decodes the official 32-element, 34-byte block layout to float32. A transparent SHA-256 prompt-to-activation probe adapter consumes the exact prompt without claiming Qwen tokenization or embeddings; the bounded scalar accumulator avoids routing and vendor-BLAS output ambiguity.

reproducible_environment.gguf_import_policy: Import gguf-py directly from a clean detached checkout at the immutable revision through PYTHONPATH; do not substitute a floating PyPI package or another llama.cpp revision.
reproducible_environment.floating_point_policy: All decoded weights, activations, products, accumulator states, canonical outputs, and NumPy cross-check outputs are float32. Error calculations use float64 only after both float32 outputs are complete.
reproducible_environment.network_policy: source_checkout_shell_lines and environment_prep_shell_lines may access GitHub, a CPython distribution source selected by uv, and Python package indexes. They are explicit preparation steps and never acquire model weights. The later oracle_shell_lines invoke only the already-created interpreter and local source/model files, perform no network request, and contain no downloader.

artifact_input.local_path_policy: An operator-authorized absolute external path supplied through PULSARMLX_MODEL_GGUF. The file must remain outside the repository and is opened read-only.
artifact_input.identity_gate: Before parsing, the command requires the exact basename and byte size and computes the complete local SHA-256. Any difference from the published expected identity stops the oracle.

model_metadata_admission.rule: general.architecture must be an exact GGUF STRING/Python str equal to qwen3moe. Each numeric key must be an exact GGUF UINT32/Python int (bool rejected) equal to its predeclared value. GGUFReader rejects duplicate field names while parsing; missing, duplicate, differently typed, or different values stop before dequantization.

tensor_admission.orientation: GGUF dimensions are fastest-axis-first [input_columns, output_rows, experts]. GGUFReader reverses them for NumPy; dequantized indexing is [expert, output_row, input_column]. No transpose is permitted.

deterministic_input.prompt: PulsarMLX real-model oracle v1: Qwen3-30B-A3B Q8_0, blk.0.ffn_gate_exps.weight, expert 0, rows 0:16.
deterministic_input.prompt_policy: The exact UTF-8 prompt is computationally consumed by the transparent probe adapter below. The adapter is deliberately not Qwen tokenization, embedding, or inference and cannot establish prompt-level model behavior.
deterministic_input.reason: The comparison boundary begins at an expert projection input. The deterministic adapter makes every activation element depend on the exact prompt digest while excluding chat-template, tokenizer, embedding, normalization, attention, and routing interpretations.
deterministic_input.rounding: SHA-256 digest bytes and integer arithmetic are exact; division by 128 produces an exactly representable binary value, then the result is stored as IEEE-754 float32.

comparison_policy.reference: the 16 canonical scalar float32 values emitted by the trusted-reference command and committed by T061
comparison_policy.apple_candidate: the 16 evaluated and synchronized MLX float32 values for the identical admitted bytes, orientation, activation, expert, and rows
comparison_policy.non_finite_policy: reject either output in full if any input, decoded weight, product, accumulator, reference value, candidate value, or error metric is NaN or infinity
comparison_policy.mismatch_policy: zero mismatches are allowed; report compared_count, mismatch_count, maximum absolute error, maximum relative error, and the first mismatching index with bounded reference/candidate/error values
comparison_policy.relative_error_denominator: max(abs(reference), float32 smallest positive normal) for reporting only; the pass expression uses the unmodified abs(reference)
comparison_policy.checksum_policy: Record activation, encoded-slice, decoded-slice, and output SHA-256 values as supplementary identity evidence. A checksum never replaces the numeric comparison.
comparison_policy.post_result_change_policy: Do not loosen or reinterpret this policy after viewing trusted-reference or Apple output. A scientifically justified replacement requires a new versioned oracle contract selected before rerunning Apple output.

trusted_reference_self_check.purpose: Detect dequantization, orientation, dtype, or accumulation mistakes before the scalar values become the Apple reference.
trusted_reference_self_check.required_result: all 16 values finite and all 16 comparisons pass
trusted_reference_self_check.failure_action: Stop US4. Do not emit or adopt reference values and do not run the Apple slice until an independently reviewable new oracle contract is frozen.

official_sources.observed: The official repository resolves the exact commit.

official_sources.purpose: gguf-py package identity and Python/dependency policy
official_sources.observed: Project gguf version 0.19.0 requires Python >=3.10 and declares NumPy plus its reader-package dependencies.

official_sources.purpose: GGUF tensor shape and read behavior
official_sources.observed: GGUFReader records fastest-axis-first dimensions, reverses them for NumPy data, and uses quantized byte shapes.
Q8_0 dequantization reads a float16 scale and 32 signed int8 values per block and returns float32 products.
Q8_0 is declared as 32 logical elements in 34 encoded bytes.
The gate expert tensor is created with dimensions {embedding, expert feed-forward, expert count}.
The official Qwen repository revision publishes the exact Q8_0 filename, size, LFS SHA-256, and qwen3moe repository architecture recorded by the separate compatibility gate.
The immutable official base-model config declares hidden size 2048, MoE intermediate size 768, and 128 experts. These are predeclared admission values, not observations from the unacquired GGUF.
